parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
Personal access token.  
This field is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret or temporary authorization from Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Starting line of the file. If empty, the entire file content is retrieved.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch name, tag name, or commit version number

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Ending line of the file. This parameter is valid only when from is not empty.
